title: Using a sample catalogue in training
passage: For the training demo, open the sample catalogue, not the one our customers use. The sample catalogue works without an internet connection. A grey picture means the image file is not on this tablet. It does not mean the product is unavailable. If you get a question about stock, say the sample figures are for training only. Nobody should promise availability based on those figures. After class, note which picture was grey and send the product code to our media team. They can add the missing image to the sample catalogue before the next session.
passageZh: 訓練示範時，請打開範例目錄，不要開啟客戶使用的目錄。範例目錄沒有網路也能用。圖片顯示灰色，表示這台平板沒有該圖片檔，不代表商品缺貨。如果有人問庫存，請說明範例數字只供訓練，不得據此向人保證有貨。下課後記下哪張圖片呈灰色，並把商品代碼寄給媒體團隊；他們能在下次上課前把缺少的圖補進範例目錄。
